title: 第46章 发工资了
content_zh:
第46章 发工资了-《系统送编，从外卖员成007探员》

上一章

下一章

苏楠手头还有事要处理，顾承安也不好继续在人家办公的地方蹭空调，起身告辞。

骑电驴回去的路上，鹏城的太阳总算收敛了几分毒辣。

下午在市局签字的时候，顾承安才想起一件事——培训结束后从后勤处领的工资卡，到现在还没绑定呢。

他一直在外面跑任务，回来又忙着处理杂事。

回到出租屋，顾承安踢掉鞋，往沙发上一瘫。

意念一动，一张东大银行的银行卡出现在手里。

卡面是标准的中行蓝，卡号、姓名、有效期一应俱全，看上去跟满大街的储蓄卡没什么两样。

但这张卡的内核，跟普通银行卡完全不是一个东西。

权限特殊，除非本人持实体卡片去柜台查询，就这查询的信息还受限。否则单是银行端查不到任何信息的，不会出现在任何常规的关联列表中。

说白了，这张卡在银行系统里是“隐身”的。

顾承安掏出手机，下载了东大银行APP。

注册登录，刷脸验证，一气呵成。

他先试了“一键关联”功能——身份证号、手机号都对，系统转了个圈，弹出结果：

未查询到可关联账户。

顾承安挑了挑眉。

果然。

他又换了个方式，选择“手动添加卡片”，拿手机对准卡面拍照，上传卡面信息。

这次通过了。

绑定成功后，APP界面上多出一张卡，显示内容和普通储蓄卡一模一样——余额、交易明细、转账功能，一个不少。

他点进余额一看。

7,346.28元。

上个月中旬左右系统给入的职，算下来只干了半个月，还是实习期，半个月就发了七千多？

顾承安在心里默默换算了一下，转正之后一个月到手至少一万五往上走。

基础薪资加绩效加各类补贴，岗位津贴，对于一个刚毕业的应届生来说，这待遇放在鹏城也相当能打了。

当然，代价是有时候真要玩命。

六险二金也交，只不过六险在普通社保系统里查不到，但医保可以正常刷卡用；公积金更特殊，直接隐藏处理，需要用的时候向上面打报告，自有人对接。

万一以后转岗到其他部门，六险二金可以无缝转出，缴纳单位那一栏不会显示任何跟国安沾边的字眼。

Su Nan still had things to deal with, and Gu Chengan couldn't continue to use the air conditioner in his office, so he stood up and left.

On the way back on the eDonkey, the sun in Pengcheng finally became a little less vicious.

While signing at the city bureau in the afternoon, Gu Chengan remembered something - the salary card he received from the logistics office after the training had not been bound yet.

He has been running tasks outside, and when he comes back, he is busy doing chores.

Back at the rental house, Gu Chengan kicked off his shoes and slumped down on the sofa.

With a thought, a bank card from Dongda Bank appeared in his hand.

The card surface is standard Bank of China blue, with the card number, name, and expiration date all available. It looks no different from the savings cards on the street.

But the core of this card is completely different from an ordinary bank card.

The permissions are special. Unless I go to the counter with a physical card to inquire, the information I can query is still limited.Otherwise, no information can be found on the bank side, and it will not appear in any regular association list.

To put it bluntly, this card is "invisible" in the banking system.

Gu Chengan took out his mobile phone and downloaded the Dongda Bank APP.

Register and log in, scan your face to verify, all in one go.

He first tried the "one-click association" function - the ID number and mobile phone number were both correct. The system went around in a circle and the result popped up:

No associated account found.

Gu Chengan raised his eyebrows.

really.

He changed the method again, choosing "manually add card", pointing his phone at the card surface to take a photo, and uploading the card surface information.

This time it passed.

After the binding is successful, an additional card will appear on the APP interface, and the displayed content is exactly the same as that of an ordinary savings card - balance, transaction details, transfer functions, and more.

He clicked on the balance to see.

7,346.28 yuan.

The system offered me a job around the middle of last month, and I only worked for half a month. Was it still during the internship period, and I was paid more than 7,000 yuan in half a month?

Gu Chengan silently calculated in his mind that after becoming a full-time employee, he would earn at least 15,000 yuan a month and go up.

Basic salary plus performance plus various subsidies and job allowances. For a fresh graduate, this treatment is quite impressive in Pengcheng.

Of course, the price is that sometimes you really have to risk your life.

Six insurances and two funds are also paid, but the six insurances cannot be found in the ordinary social security system, but the medical insurance can be used by swiping the card normally; the provident fund is more special, and is directly hidden and processed. When you need to use it, you will report it to the superiors and someone will handle it.

In case of transfer to other departments in the future, the six insurances and two funds can be transferred out seamlessly, and the column of the paying unit will not display any words related to national security.
